sections.heading: Planning your Vela Bay interior
sections.text:
A “bay” name in this district often comes with marketing language about water, breeze and outdoor living. We will not assign a view, a breeze or a walking time to the coast from your stack. What we can plan, once your approved floor plan is in hand, is the joinery that makes a new east-coast apartment easy to live in: an entry cabinet for shoes and bags, a living-room storage wall that can sit cleanly against a balcony opening, full-height bedroom wardrobes, and a fitted kitchen with a tall pantry. If the living room is long and narrow, a continuous joinery wall is usually calmer than a loose television bench and a cluster of cabinets. Maison specifies built-in carpentry, not IKEA-style furniture, and we are happy to work in close, material-led photographs as well as a traditional wide shot.

No official floor plan is on file, so typologies and room sizes are not listed. Pinery Residences is another District 16 project in this batch; use that page as a nearby link, not as a stand-in for your own layout. Before you plan balcony cabinets, screens or a window bench, read the management corporation’s rules and visit the unit at more than one time of day, because east-coast light and rain can be quite different in the late afternoon.

After keys, inspect defects first, then measure and apply for renovation approval. A moderate, non-structural carpentry scope is often planned at six to ten weeks on site after access and approvals — an editorial allowance, not a promise. WhatsApp Maison with your approved plan and any key date you have in writing. We are not affiliated with the developer.
